caseNameFull: D. J. Burke v. Monumental Division No. 52, Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers
attorneys: Mr. Cyrus G. Derr, with whom Mr. F. D. McKenney was oil the brief, for appellant. Messrs. Oscar J. Horn and Arthur L. Jackson for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Reversed with costs, with directions to dismiss the bill for lack of allegation disclosing any ground for Federal jurisdiction.
